Chapter 784: Chapter 9 Heaven, Earth, Humans, Ghosts, Gods, All Worship Martial Ancestor (Subscription Requested)

“What’s going on?”

Lin Yuan stared at the towering Door to the Myriad Realms.

He immediately realized that the fluctuation did not come from the Door to the Myriad Realms.

Instead, it was transmitted from the many worlds connected to the Door to the Myriad Realms.

The Door to the Myriad Realms was merely a “Transfer” point, just a “medium.”

“Which world did it come from…”

...

Lin Yuan looked towards the bottom of the Door to the Myriad Realms, where ten world coordinates were sequentially engraved.

They represented the nine worlds Lin Yuan had previously traveled through and the Immortal Realm, which he had not yet descended into.

“Tianqing World?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze landed on the world mark of Tianqing World.

The source of the disturbance was indeed Tianqing World.

Before Lin Yuan descended into Tianqing World, that place was facing an invasion by a Foreign Evil God.

At that time, Lin Yuan took control of a branch of the Ancestral Demon Tree, the Foreign Evil God, and ultimately replaced the Ancestral Demon Tree, replacing the Heavenly Dao of Tianqing World.

He became the absolute Dominion of that world.

Lin Yuan had a significant impression of Tianqing World.

Because the so-called Tianqing World is but a small world within the Boundless Void.

Beyond Tianqing World lays the playground of the Evil Gods.

Unfortunately, Lin Yuan was short on time after replacing the Heavenly Dao of Tianqing World, and his stay was nearly up.

He couldn’t continue to explore the Boundless Void beyond the world.

However, because of becoming the Heavenly Dao of Tianqing World and leveraging the body of the Ancestral Demon Tree left behind,

he could, through the Door to the Myriad Realms’ “Transfer,” barely communicate between the two worlds.

Even if he didn’t descend to Tianqing World, he could still transmit messages through the Ancestral Demon Tree and roughly get some information about Tianqing World.

When he had just returned from Tianqing World, Lin Yuan was quite interested in it and often inquired about the development of Tianqing World.

But as time went on, he let it go, only receiving the Ancestral Demon Tree’s regular “reports” every so often and not paying much attention.

But now?

The body of the Ancestral Demon Tree in Tianqing World had taken the initiative to send messages to Lin Yuan.

In the contingencies Lin Yuan had left behind, only in an extremely urgent situation would this happen.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan’s consciousness immediately began to follow the coordinates of Tianqing World, receiving messages from the Ancestral Demon Tree.

“Another invasion by a Foreign Evil God?”

Lin Yuan looked thoughtful, contemplating the ratio of the time flow speed between Tianqing World and the Main Universe.

It was six hundred to one.

Six hundred years had passed in Tianqing World.

Only one year had passed in the Main Universe.

And it had been about three hundred years since Lin Yuan ended his traversal of Tianqing World.

That is to say, nearly two hundred thousand years had already passed there.

“Could it be those two Foreign Evil Gods invading Tianqing World?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself quietly. After replacing the Ancestral Demon Tree, he had also inherited its “network.”

At that time, beyond Tianqing World, besides the Ancestral Demon Tree, there were also two ancient Foreign Evil Gods lurking.

These two Foreign Evil Gods behind likely had even more powerful Foreign Evil Gods standing with them.

After Lin Yuan became the Heavenly Dao of Tianqing World, he had some interactions with those two Foreign Evil Gods and vaguely realized that they seemed to harbor ill intentions toward him.

Because they had more than once invited him to explore a certain Secret Realm in the Boundless Void.

But Lin Yuan had flatly refused them since he didn’t have much time left and only wanted to peacefully secure Tianqing World.

As for the opportunity of the Secret Realm in the Foreign Boundless Void? The risk was too great and did not align with the goals Lin Yuan had set.

Moreover, Lin Yuan also kept his guard up against those two Foreign Evil Gods, understanding that the “relationship” between Evil Gods was almost equivalent to having no relationship at all.

If it were within their power, those two Foreign Evil Gods would not hesitate to devour Lin Yuan.

“After hundreds of thousands of years, why suddenly think of invading Tianqing World?” Lin Yuan was slightly curious.

Evil Gods invade worlds but also look at the situation.

Tianqing World had the Ancestral Demon Tree as its stronghold; it had many contingencies left by Lin Yuan.

Those two Foreign Evil Gods would have to pay a harsh price to conquer Tianqing World, where the cost completely outweighed the gain.

Moreover, just with those two Foreign Evil Gods, the chances were high that they couldn’t take down Tianqing World. Now that the Ancestral Demon Tree was reaching out to him, they probably used a higher level of tactics.

And such tactics, being extremely precious, were simply not worth using to invade Tianqing World.

“It must be that some changes have occurred in Tianqing World over these hundreds of thousands of years.”

“Or perhaps some changes in the Boundless Void prompted those two Foreign Evil Gods to forcefully invade.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

“What should I do now?”

Lin Yuan stroked his chin.

The Ancestral Demon Tree had sent a distress signal, clearly stating that the situation in Tianqing World had become extremely dire.

It had far surpassed the time when Lin Yuan had originally descended, and the power of those two Foreign Evil Gods had already penetrated into Tianqing World.

Under such circumstances, if Lin Yuan did nothing, the entire Tianqing World would change hands.

“Very well.”

“I shall descend once more.”

Lin Yuan had made up his mind.

To Lin Yuan, Tianqing World still held many unknown secrets and many terrifying and powerful Evil Gods that ravaged world after world.

The upper limit of Tianqing World was not high, but beyond it, the mysterious Boundless Void had a much higher ceiling.

According to Lin Yuan’s estimation, the entire Boundless Void, even if not comparable to the Immortal Realm, was not far off, where the strongest Evil God might reach the Eleventh Rank Peak.

…

This time, Lin Yuan’s re-descent to Tianqing World took in three considerations.

Firstly, Tianqing World was literally his backyard, where the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was supreme—the most populous world among the many Lin Yuan had traversed with Martial Dao Cultivators.
